components.sublabel: Files and variables of one dataset

components.label: Variable instance
components.sublabel: A concrete variable in a dataset

components.label: Data file
components.sublabel: One physical file in a dataset

cards.title: Edge meanings
items: part-of-product — this dataset belongs to this product
contains — the dataset holds this variable
present-in — the variable occurs in this file, with its physical type
defined-by — the definition this variable implements (the authoritative edge)
has-candidate-definitions — inferred candidates, carrying evidence and score
owned-by — the team responsible for maintaining the definition
accessible-by — the group granted read access
classified-by — the classification or code list that defines the value domain

cards.title: Reference shape
items: { predicate, target: { service, entity_type, key, as_of }, provenance }
target is a closed node reference; the predicate is carried by the field or the edge list entry
String form: urn:ssb:<service>:<entity-type>:<key>[@<as-of>]
Example: urn:ssb:vardef:variable-definition:a1b2c3d4@2026-10-29
Per-predicate payload examples are in docs/metadata-relationships.md

cards.title: Rules
items: Each predicate declares cardinality, requiredness, as_of, resolution rule, inverse, provenance and status
Typed field where cardinality is constrained; open edge list where it is not
No shadowing: each concept is owned by exactly one entity
Every edge carries provenance: authored, inferred or imported

cards.title: Out of scope
items: All klass-owned relationships: family, version, parent codes, correspondence tables
datadoc edges below has-candidate-definitions: data source, sentinel codes, subject area, owning section
The model may be expanded to these later if needed

cards.title: Not modelled
items: Value objects stay inline: time-period, contact, language-string
Not nodes: pseudonymization key, free-URL fields
Definition-to-definition edges (same-as, supersedes, merged-into, derived-from) cannot be drawn as self-edges
